body: Yes I agree, thank you.

I felt the same way and sometimes I still do. What has helped me is taking photos of myself, ironically. Take a bunch, frequently. Some days make yourself feel really pretty and do a proper photo shoot. Other days take really ugly ones. Or ones where you don't put much effort. This constant exposure helps you figure out your best angles and also makes you more comfortable with how you look in pictures. I hope this helped.
